articles.title: SBI ordered to pay retired scientist Rs 15L after failing to inform about FD maturity
articles.description: A retired scientist took legal action against State Bank of India for failing to inform him about his deposit's maturity. The consumer commission determined that SBI did not communicate properly regarding the deposit and extension options. As a result, the commission found SBI had retained his funds without justification after maturity. The commission ordered the bank to pay him the original deposit amount along with interest.

Casual laborers who fulfill certain conditions are equally entitled to this non-PLB payment, all amounts finalized by the nearest rupee based on the established calculations.

This initiative intends to help researchers explore and build on AI-generated mathematical results. The funding will facilitate workshops, conferences, and access to OpenAI's models for researchers. The controversy stems from claims concerning illegal plagiarism and scientific norm violations.
